purpose: Authoritative geoid-model registry and scientific acceptance checklist. This is not a sampled grid, known-answer point set, or vertical transformation implementation.

models.notes: NGA publishes worldwide interpolation grid. Treat grid variant, tide convention, interpolation, and realization as explicit metadata.
NGA publishes worldwide 2.5-minute interpolation grid and spherical harmonic coefficients. Do not silently substitute EGM2008 for a dataset explicitly declared EGM96.

provenance.source: NGA Office of Geomatics WGS 84 data
provenance.role: Model status, grid resolution, and official download listings
Secondary packaging reference; describes converted grid format and public-domain status for listed converted NGA grids
Scientific caution on geoid realization and conventions

acceptance_gates: Obtain and pin a complete official or explicitly traceable grid artifact; never download it dynamically during CI.
Record the exact file SHA-256 and verify it before loading.
Use at least one numerical point value from an independently published authoritative source or independently derived, documented oracle; do not use the same library under test as sole oracle.
Test grid node values and interior interpolation separately, including axis order, longitude wrap, grid edge, outside coverage, nodata, and missing-grid behavior.

Verify vertical operation sign convention with a known pair: h_ellipsoid = H_orthometric + N, with N defined by the selected model; do not assume every national datum uses this relationship without its operation metadata.
Report transformation accuracy/uncertainty and operation/grid provenance; reject unavailable or out-of-area operations rather than silently falling back.
